hints.title: Row-by-Row Score Tracking
hints.text: Track the maximum score achieved ending at each column of the previous row to inform current row selections.

hints.title: Splitting Distance Penalties
hints.text: For c_prev <= c_curr, the penalty is c_curr - c_prev. For c_prev >= c_curr, the penalty is c_prev - c_curr.

hints.title: Left and Right Prefix Sweeps
hints.text: Precompute running maximums from left to right and from right to left in O(N) to eliminate the nested column loop.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Dynamic programming with left/right linear prefix and suffix rolling sweeps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every pair of columns between consecutive rows takes O(M * N^2) time, which times out for N = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix/suffix sweeps reduce quadratic column transitions to linear time with O(N) rolling space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize separating abs(c1 - c2) into left and right linear passes.
